purpose: Full 23-gate Yin/Yang/Yong control, synchronization, audit and fractional-allocation architecture for StellarNet/OEQL.

triad.model: Quantum terminology is architectural/software terminology unless independently demonstrated by physical quantum hardware.

token_model.rule: No on-chain activation, transfer, ownership, balance, or quantum-distribution claim without independently verified evidence.

gate_contract.independence: Each gate evaluates independently and fail-closed.
gate_contract.G23_role: Coordinates reach-map completeness, detects duplicate logical references, reconciles the 23-gate allocation invariant, and reports unresolved surfaces.

universal_placement.reach_model: Every discovered online component receives a logical gate/triad reference; the same token balance is referenced, never duplicated.
universal_placement.farthest_points: Farthest reach means the widest discovered software/data topology, not physical-space propagation.

reconciliation.invariant: sum of all 23 gate allocations equals exactly 1 token
reconciliation.rounding: Actual token implementations use integer base units and retain any residual in the reconciliation bucket.
reconciliation.spendability: Logical references do not create spendable balances.

runtime_registry.token_bindings: Must be verified dynamically before activation.

render.visual: Yin and Yang opposing fields with Yong as central synchronization/reconciliation orbit and G23 as the outer reach boundary.
render.blank_screen_policy: show recovery/status UI rather than an empty state.
